messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: primary-east1 gpu-pool queue length > 95% (14m) — autoscaler not increasing, enqueue rate high. Pager triggered to @Irene (oncall)
Irene (oncall): acked, on it. What do we know about autoscale errors?
Maya (SRE): seeing scale-up attempts but nodes stuck in PROVISIONING -> FAILED. cloud API returns quota error for GPUs: "InsufficientResourceQuota". Also kube events show pods pending due to no nodes.
Jon (Infra): confirming. Cloud quota for gpus-east1 is at hard limit; there's a pending quota increase request but it's not approved yet.
Sam (Runtime): traffic pattern: sudden burst from a large customer in EU; continuous batching increased token rate. primary-east1 model-serving pools overloaded. Routing tried spillover to eu1.
Alex (pager): customers reporting 429s and some 504s; support seeing higher error rates on /v1/generate. Donna (Support): live messages from a customer saying "generations timing out, degraded UX".
Irene (oncall): okay triage plan: (1) confirm customer impact, (2) enable spillover to backup pools, (3) free up capacity by preempting low-priority jobs, (4) escalate quota request and consider manual reserve. Who can flip spillover routing?
Sam (Runtime): I can. Routing policy is currently strict about model_variant compatibility, so some requests failed when routed to eu1 because eu1 doesn't have the quantized variant. I can relax the compatibility check to allow variant fallback for 15m.
Jon (Infra): can we do temp capacity from Dedicated spare? We have one warm-reserve pool in us-west that can take some traffic for compatible models. Needs manual enable.
Maya (SRE): I'm running quick impact query: 
```
# queue length
redis-cli -h redis-east1 llen request_queue:primary-east1
> 1824
# inflight
curl -s 'https://internal-metrics/api/pools/primary-east1' | jq '.active_requests, .queued'
> 648, 1824
``` 
Irene (oncall): yikes. Those queuelengths map to ~2.3m tokens backlog. Customer impact high. Donna estimate: ~12 major customers seeing elevated p50 latency > 4s and 6 customers with request errors.
Alex (pager): some requests hit eu1 and returned 502s with error: 
```
{"error":"model_variant_not_available","msg":"requested variant vq-8 not present in region"}
```
Sam (Runtime): OK relaxing compatibility now. I'll update routing policy to allow variant fallback to closest compatible variant and enable spillover weight to eu1/us-west. Rolling change: 2s TTL and circuit breaker at 20% error.
Sam (Runtime): applying change...
ops-bot: deploy started by Sam (Runtime) — routing-config v2026.03.15-834
Sam (Runtime): changed. routing weights: primary-east1 70, eu1 20, us-west 10. variant fallback allowed.
Irene (oncall): monitoring for error spikes and latency. Jon — can you enable the warm-reserve in us-west?
Jon (Infra): initiating manual enable of warm-reserve pool. Command: 
```
gcloud compute instances group set-autoscaling warm-reserve-us-west --max-num-replicas=12 --min-num-replicas=2
```
Jon (Infra): warm-reserve scaling to 8 nodes now (takes ~2min).
Maya (SRE): while that completes, I'm going to preempt low-priority batch jobs. Script: 
```
kubectl label jobs batch-low-priority preempt=true && kubectl delete pods -l preempt=true -n runtime-batch
```
Maya (SRE): batch pod evictions started. Should free ~4 GPUs.
Irene (oncall): good. Also escalate quota request — Jon, please page cloud ops for emergency quota bump.
Jon (Infra): paging cloud-quotas: @cloud-quotas emergency request for +20 GPUs in east1. Ticket: https://cloud/.../ticket/78910
ops-bot: cloud ticket 78910 updated: awaiting approval. SLA shows manual approval required.
Alex (pager): support reports timeouts dropping slightly after routing change, but some customers still see failures due to session affinity and KV-cache miss between regions.
Sam (Runtime): noted. Cross-region cache miss causes cold starts and extra latency. I'm enabling prefix-KV share for small keys between east1 and eu1 for the affected models — risk: slight increase in cross-region egress. Enabling now.
Sam (Runtime): kv-share toggle on.
Maya (SRE): queue length dropping: redis-cli llen request_queue:primary-east1 -> 1220. Inflight -> 412.
Donna (Support): posting update to customers: "We're routing excess traffic to backup regions and preempting non-critical jobs. Latency improving; working on full capacity restoration." :thumbsup:
Irene (oncall): timeline update: 00:00 alert, 00:04 routing fallback enabled, 00:07 warm-reserve scaled, 00:09 batch preemptions, 00:12 kv-share on. Current status: degraded but improving.
ops-bot: incident note auto-generated — incident id inc-3612345678.
Jon (Infra): cloud quotas approved for +10 GPUs (partial) — applied. Autoscaler picked up new quota and started provisioning 6 more nodes.
Maya (SRE): provisioning logs: 
```
2026-03-15T00:18:23Z PROVISIONING node-xx started
2026-03-15T00:19:51Z PROVISIONING node-xx succeeded
```
Maya (SRE): queue now at 310, inflight 88. p50 latency trending back to baseline.
Alex (pager): support: customers thanked for quick updates, 2 customers still on degraded experience for a short window. No P1s.
Irene (oncall): plan to keep routing relax for 30min, let warm-reserve drain, and then revert compatibility back. Sam please put a rollback timer.
Sam (Runtime): rollback timer set for 30m, will auto-revert unless we extend. Also creating a postmortem ticket to capture: autoscaler failure due to quota bottleneck + model variant distribution mismatch across regions + lack of pre-warm capacity.
Donna (Support): adding customer impact notes to the ticket, including sample customer IDs and timestamps.
Irene (oncall): closing handoff to follow-up rotation: @Maya please own next 4h for mitigations & postmortem. I'll hand to oncall-north in 30m.
Maya (SRE): will do. final status: mitigation successful, partial quota manual bump, routing spillover + warm-reserve prevented widespread outages. Reopen if we see regression. :white_check_mark:
